17df85ccf35b0ceb44ef6f8f841e0af3e5da1cf3: Gréolières-les-Neiges is a modest, low-key resort with 20 km of runs, offering an intimate skiing experience far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Gréolières-les-Neiges' family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Southern Alps for getting children started on skiing. The modest altitude of Gréolières-les-Neiges, starting at 1400 m and reaching 1800 m at the top, makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking the snow reports before you leave is strongly advised. With a day lift pass at just 22€, Gréolières-les-Neiges is one of the most affordable destinations in France. For families on a tight budget, or skiers who want to make the most of their days without breaking the bank, it is a sincere and often overlooked choice. In short, Gréolières-les-Neiges does not compete with the giants of skiing, and does not pretend to. It is an honest destination, often underrated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
